summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a stock purchase agreement to acquire all issued shares of Meals Through Seasons Limited, a BVI entity holding Meals Though Seasons HK Limited, from Hongs Smart Limited and Yapjianhuei Smart Limited, for US$510,000,000 in securities. Consideration comprises 150,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.00 reference price (US$150M) and US$360M unsecured convertible promissory notes. The target operates organic agricultural supply chains. No cash, independent valuation, or fairness opinion obtained; financials unaudited. The MOU was previously non-binding. Watch for definitive agreement and regulatory approval risks given reliance on unverified seller forecasts.
